# opusdns_domain_dnssec (Data Source)

Reads the current DNSSEC configuration for an OpusDNS domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opusdns_domain_dnssec" "example" {
  domain_ref = "example.com"
}

output "ds_records" {
  value = data.opusdns_domain_dnssec.example.records
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_ref` (String) Reference to the domain. Accepts either the domain id or the domain name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier (the domain reference).
- `records` (Attributes List) DNSSEC records currently registered for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (Number) DNSSEC algorithm number.
- `created_on` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `digest` (String) DS record digest.
- `digest_type` (Number) DS digest type.
- `flags` (Number) DNSKEY flags.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier for the DNSSEC record.
- `key_tag` (Number) Key tag.
- `protocol` (Number) DNSKEY protocol field.
- `public_key` (String) DNSKEY public key.
- `record_type` (String) Record type: `ds_data` or `key_data`.
- `updated_on` (String) RFC3339 update timestamp.
